title: Move to Action: Turning Crucial Conversations Into Results
heading: Chapter 09
chapterLocalFacts: The chapter teaches four decision modes: command, consult, vote, and consensus.
The reader should pick the decision mode up front instead of drifting into it.
Pretending to consult when the decision is already made is a central failure mode.
The chapter closes decisions through WWWF: who, what, when, and follow-up.
bridgeForward: Chapter 10 handles tough cases and warns that the framework only works when the user is genuinely open to change.

quoteLedger.text: Who does What by When, and how will we Follow up?
